summary: Hyperscale Data, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting the termination of its At-the-Market Issuance Sales Agreement with Spartan Capital Securities. The ATM had generated ~$24.7M gross proceeds from ~137.6M shares at ~$0.1793/share. The termination is effective June 8, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, or special-situation catalyst is present. This is a routine termination of a capital-raising facility, not a special situation event.
